meta.name: recall-before-claim
meta.description: Forces a memory_search before the agent sends a message containing a factual assertion that has not yet been grounded this turn. Closes the citation-rate gap from ~40% to ~90%+.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体在陈述事实前自动检索记忆，提升引用准确率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望智能体回答时能主动引用已有记忆，减少编造
copy.tagline_en: Force memory search before factual claims, boosting citation rate from ~40% to 90%+
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to ground its claims in memory before speaking

howto.what: Claude 在回复前，如果发现消息中包含未经核实的事实性断言（如“X是Y”），会先自动执行一次记忆搜索，确保引用已有记忆后再发送。
howto.when: 当 Claude 准备发送的消息中包含事实性断言，且本轮对话中尚未使用过记忆搜索工具时触发。

say.text: 请告诉我关于张三的项目进展。
say.note: Claude 会先搜索记忆再回答。

say.text: 李四上次会议说了什么？
say.note: 触发记忆搜索，确保回答有依据。

howto.what_en: Before sending a message with an unverified factual assertion (e.g., "X is Y"), Claude automatically runs a memory search to ground the claim using stored memories.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude is about to send a message containing a factual assertion and no memory tool has been used in the current turn.

say_en.text: Tell me about Zhang San's project progress.
say_en.note: Claude will search memory before answering.

say_en.text: What did Li Si say in the last meeting?
say_en.note: Triggers memory search for grounded response.
